credits: Painted from family photos of Olivia, Zero, Belle, and home.
title: Olivia and the Lost Rock
subtitle: Sisters help find treasure.
blurb: Zero's favorite rock goes missing. Belle has an idea. Olivia leads the search across the patio, the garden, and the grass until the treasure comes home.

magic.rock: There it is. Smooth as a secret.

pages.heading: The rock is gone
pages.text: {Zero:zero/sniff} looked at her paws. The smooth {rock:rock/clack} was not there. {Olivia} said, "We will find it." {Belle:belle/wag}'s tail said, I have an idea.

pages.heading: Belle's idea
pages.text: {Belle:belle/run} zoomed across the {yard}. Maybe she took it. Maybe she was helping. {Olivia:olivia/run} and {Zero:zero/run} followed, because that is what a search party does.

pages.heading: Under the chairs
pages.text: They looked under the wooden chairs. They looked by the picnic table. No {rock:rock/clack}. {Olivia:olivia/ask} said, "Where would a treasure hide?"

pages.heading: In the garden
pages.text: The {garden} smelled like dirt and leaves. {Zero:zero/sniff} put her nose down. {Belle:belle/wreck} splashed a watering pot. {Olivia} looked between the green.

pages.heading: There it is
pages.text: In the grass sat the {rock:rock/find}. Smooth as a secret. {Zero:zero/wag} nosed it kind. {Belle:belle/wag} dropped a tiny pebble beside it. "Yours," said the pebble.

pages.heading: Treasure home
pages.text: {Olivia} carried the {rock:rock/clack} as far as the patio. Then she gave it back. {Zero:zero/sleep} kept it. {Belle:belle/wag} kept bouncing. The search was done.

end.heading: The End
end.text: You {read} the whole {story}. Lost things can come home when sisters look together.
end.prompt: If you lost a treasure, who would help you look?
